required_checks: current report and protocol-plan schema validation
notes: This major release removes legacy RUN indexes, trace authoring, report selectors, semantic plan copies and old PLAN/report schemas. SQLite plus run.json/timeline.jsonl becomes the runtime authority, stage start/finish owns deterministic reports, and protocol plan.json becomes the sole semantic plan. There is no legacy reader or in-place active-RUN migration: finish or discard old-format active RUNs before upgrade. Compatible dd-flow-cli 0.5.0 and mb-lint 0.4.0 are required.
